tokens.name: color-page
tokens.usage: Page ground behind everything. Also the text color on ink fills (code blocks, tooltips, the current page in pagination).

tokens.name: color-hero
tokens.usage: Title bands: the hero and the page head, under the isometric grid. The one ground a page uses to mark its top.

tokens.name: color-card
tokens.usage: Solid inner grounds: inline code, tag chips, the Range stage. Use where a frosted surface would be too faint.

tokens.name: color-surface
tokens.usage: Frosted card fill for lists, rows and blockquotes, over color-page. Pair with color-border.

tokens.name: color-surface-strong
tokens.usage: The sticky navigation bar, with a 16px backdrop blur. Falls back to color-page without backdrop-filter.

tokens.name: color-surface-ghost
tokens.usage: Ghost buttons and pagination links at rest; the hover fill of a linked card.

tokens.name: color-ink
tokens.usage: Headings, body text and pixel outlines on color-page, color-hero, color-card and the surfaces (11:1 or better). Also the hard pixel shadow and the focus outline.

tokens.name: color-ink-muted
tokens.usage: Ledes, descriptions, labels and captions on color-page (7.2:1), color-hero (6.3:1) and color-card (6.2:1).

tokens.name: color-earth
tokens.usage: Source hue for borders and the grid; use the alpha tokens below, not this value, for lines. Solid only in pixel art.

tokens.name: color-border
tokens.usage: Hairline around cards, rows, images and table rows. Decorative: it does not carry meaning on its own.

tokens.name: color-border-strong
tokens.usage: Hover border on cards; ghost button and pagination outlines; the dashed outline of a locked row. Kept from source at 1.4:1 on color-page, under the 3:1 control-border floor, so a control must also read by its fill and label.

tokens.name: color-grid
tokens.usage: The faint isometric grid lines (32 × 16 tile) behind title bands and stages. Never behind body copy.

tokens.name: color-accent
tokens.usage: The one brand hue: primary buttons, the Contact pill, links, the J of the mark and the second clause of the hero title. Text in it reads on color-page (5.3:1), color-hero (4.7:1) and color-card (4.6:1).

tokens.name: color-accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover state of links and accent fills.

tokens.name: color-on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on color-accent (5.4:1) and color-accent-hover (8.1:1).

tokens.name: color-gold
tokens.usage: One emphasized phrase on color-forest (5.3:1), and a fill under color-ink text (7.8:1). Never text on light grounds.

tokens.name: color-forest
tokens.usage: Ground of a dark section, such as Range. At most one per page.

tokens.name: color-on-forest
tokens.usage: Headings and the focus outline on color-forest (8.8:1).

tokens.name: color-on-forest-muted
tokens.usage: Body copy on color-forest (6.7:1).

tokens.name: color-on-forest-surface
tokens.usage: Frosted panel fill inside a color-forest section.

tokens.name: color-on-forest-border
tokens.usage: Hairline around a panel on color-forest.

tokens.name: color-footer
tokens.usage: Footer ground.

tokens.name: color-on-footer
tokens.usage: Footer text and links on color-footer (9.9:1).

tokens.name: syntax-comment
tokens.usage: Code comments, italic, on color-ink (5.2:1). From syntax.css, where it is a literal.

tokens.name: syntax-keyword
tokens.usage: Keywords, booleans and constants on color-ink (7.8:1).

tokens.name: syntax-string
tokens.usage: Strings, chars and attribute values on color-ink.

tokens.name: syntax-number
tokens.usage: Numbers and regexes on color-ink.

tokens.name: syntax-function
tokens.usage: Functions, decorators and annotations on color-ink.

tokens.name: syntax-class
tokens.usage: Class names, builtins, namespaces and symbols on color-ink.

tokens.name: syntax-tag
tokens.usage: Tags, properties, selectors and JSON keys on color-ink.

tokens.name: syntax-attr
tokens.usage: Attribute names, keys and variables on color-ink (6.3:1).

tokens.name: syntax-punctuation
tokens.usage: Operators, punctuation and entities on color-ink.

tokens.name: syntax-deleted
tokens.usage: Background of deleted lines in a diff block.

tokens.name: syntax-inserted
tokens.usage: Background of inserted lines in a diff block.

styles.name: hero-title
styles.sample: I take software from estimate to production.
styles.usage: The one hero heading. Fluid: clamp(44px, 5.6vw, 76px).

styles.name: section-title
styles.usage: Home section headings. Fluid: clamp(36px–40px, 5vw, 64px).

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: Page titles in the page head. Fluid: clamp(32px, 4vw, 48px).

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: Sections inside a page or post.

styles.name: h3
styles.usage: Subsections.

styles.name: lede
styles.sample: Senior developer and tech lead. I own delivery end to end, from estimate to release.
styles.usage: The paragraph under a hero or section title, in color-ink-muted.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: The pipeline loads nightly. We don't yet know how late the upstream export can land.
styles.usage: Default UI and body text.

styles.name: post-body
styles.sample: Caching moves the cost from every read to the first one.
styles.usage: Long-form reading column, 720px max.

styles.name: featured-title
styles.sample: Taking on the Cloud Resume Challenge
styles.usage: A featured post title; a subtitle on list pages.

styles.name: card-title
styles.sample: Using caching to create performant APIs
styles.usage: Titles inside cards and related posts.

styles.name: row-lead
styles.usage: The first line of a list row.

styles.name: row-short
styles.usage: The second line of a list row, in color-ink-muted.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: Figure 2. Cache miss on first read.
styles.usage: Figure captions and tooltip text.

styles.name: nav-link
styles.usage: Navigation links.

styles.name: button-ghost
styles.usage: Ghost button label.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The wordmark beside the JL mark, and the Range nameplate.

styles.name: button-primary
styles.usage: Primary button label.

styles.name: pill
styles.usage: Pill label and pagination numbers.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Kickers, dates, categories, table headers and the footer. Always uppercase, in color-ink-muted.

styles.name: tag
styles.usage: Tag chips on color-card.

styles.name: code-block
styles.usage: Code blocks on color-ink. Inline code is 0.9em of the surrounding text on color-card.

tokens.name: gutter
tokens.usage: Side padding of every section and band at widths above 480px.

tokens.name: gutter-narrow
tokens.usage: The gutter at 480px and below (the source redefines --gutter there).

tokens.name: space-card-pad-y
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of a card. From card.css.

tokens.name: space-card-pad-x
tokens.usage: Horizontal padding of a card. From card.css.

tokens.name: space-section-y
tokens.usage: Top padding of a home section (112px below); 64px / 72px at 480px and below.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: The navigation bar and the Contact pill.

tokens.name: radius-panel
tokens.usage: Large panels, and the navigation bar once it wraps to two rows.

tokens.name: radius-stage
tokens.usage: The stage inside a panel.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Cards, rows, blockquotes and featured posts.

tokens.name: radius-button
tokens.usage: Buttons, pagination, code blocks, tooltips and images in posts.

tokens.name: radius-chip
tokens.usage: Inline code and tag chips. A literal in the source, named here.

shadow.note: The pixel shadows are hard offsets with no blur: the system's one depth cue. Everything else is flat.

tokens.name: shadow-pixel
tokens.usage: Primary button at rest. Reads as a key you can press.

tokens.name: shadow-pixel-pressed
tokens.usage: Primary button while pressed, with a 2px translate.

tokens.name: shadow-pixel-accent
tokens.usage: Ink fills: code blocks, tooltips and the current page in pagination.

tokens.name: shadow-nav
tokens.usage: The sticky navigation bar only.

tokens.name: shadow-focus-halo
tokens.usage: The halo behind the 2px color-ink focus outline (offset 2px). On dark grounds, swap the halo to that ground and the outline to its on- color.

layout.note: Widths and offsets from variables.css, plus the tap-target rule from the repository's conventions.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Max width of section and band content.

tokens.name: reading-max
tokens.usage: Max width of a reading column: posts, the 404, long documents.

tokens.name: header-offset
tokens.usage: scroll-margin-top for anchors, so targets clear the sticky header.

tokens.name: tap-target
tokens.usage: Minimum height and width of anything interactive.

tokens.name: breakpoint-narrow
tokens.usage: Phone layout: gutter-narrow, wrapped navigation, stacked rows.

tokens.name: breakpoint-stack
tokens.usage: Two-column grids (featured post, related posts) stack to one column below this.
